verdict.rationale: Plymouth Street's products page promises "Transparent fees" and "Flat, scoped pricing with what's included – clearly," and contrasts itself with billable hours as "All-inclusive." Nothing in the evidence shows a pricing page that lists its own fees separately from USCIS filing fees or premium processing charges. These are generic transparency claims, adjacent to the story rather than the itemized government-versus-provider breakdown it asks for, so the verdict stays at none.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider's pricing pages separate its own fees from USCIS filing fees and premium processing, so the all-in cost is honest
